_comment: The canonical admin URL per Instatic site — the single answer to 'what link do I send?'.
`adminUrl` is the origin a person should work from; `check-origins.mjs` appends its www/apex
twin automatically, so list only what that would not derive: the platform host, staging, an
old domain people still have bookmarked.
This file is the claim; `node check-origins.mjs --all` is the proof. Re-run it after any
domain change and fix whichever of the two is wrong.
No secrets here. Credentials live in the per-worktree .env and never in this repo.

sites.note: Custom domain live. PUBLIC_ORIGIN is set explicitly on the host: apex and www both pass.

PUBLIC_ORIGIN is NOT set on the host, so it falls back to RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN. www.masonparkdental.com serves the admin but is rejected as a foreign origin — a trap. Until PUBLIC_ORIGIN is set, the Railway host is the only URL to hand out. Apex masonparkdental.com does not resolve.
